About this space

SEAGROVE COASTAL CHARMER! Easy walk to beach access!

The perfect family vacation home LOADED with amenities with a HUGE BACKYARD OASIS! Private pool with sun shelf, 2 living rooms, open concept floor plan, quartz counters throughout, indoor + outdoor living and dining spaces, spacious porches, a ping pong table - this home has it all!

6-seater LSV/Golf Cart & 4 bikes included!

Located in the Eastern Lake area of Seagrove, this location cannot be beat!

The space

Welcome to 'Morning Dew Cottage!'

This fully renovated beach home is the most perfect place to relax and unwind!

Located in the ultra-desirable neighborhood of Eastern Lake in Seagrove Beach nestled between the neighboring towns of Seacrest and Seaside/WaterColor (2 miles to the west on 30A), this charming coastal vacation home features sleeping accommodations for up to 11 guests, with plenty of space to spread out and make yourselves at home! Located on the south side of 30A!

The home has 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms and is loaded with amenities making for the perfect beach getaway!

AMENITIES:
-6-seater LSV/Golf Cart & 4 bikes included
-Private heated pool with sun shelf
-Outdoor TV + living and dining spaces
-Ping pong table
-BBQ grill
-An outdoor shower for rinsing off those sandy toes
-2 separate living spaces
-3 king bedrooms (2 master suites with full en suite bathrooms)
-6 Smart TVs throughout (including on the porch)
-6+ beach chairs for your use
-Two spacious covered front porches perfect for that morning cup of coffee or evening glass of wine
-Custom designer furnishings
-Shiplap covered walls
-Top of the line finishes throughout, no detail unnoticed
-Open concept floor plan
-White quartz counters throughout
-Large kitchen island with breakfast bar seating (3 barstools)
-String lights outside to add to the ambiance!

With comfortable coastal furnishings throughout, the chic vibe of this house sweeps you away when you first walk in and is in every detail throughout. Boasting loads of natural light, white quartz countertops throughout the kitchen and all bathrooms, an open concept floor plan, kitchen island with additional seating, stainless steel appliances, gas range, and a charming yet comfortable ambiance - no detail is forgotten! Three king bedrooms and multiple exterior lounging spaces make for plenty of room for multiple families vacationing together!

It is a short, easy walk/bike ride to the wonderful beach access, or take the LSV/golf cart to explore the area!

The beautiful private heated pool has a sun shelf perfect for little ones to play or adults to lounge! The outdoor living space also has a ping pong table next to the outdoor pool area for relaxing al fresco!

Specifically, the first floor has an open kitchen and living room that features plenty of comfortable seating. There is one king bedroom on the first floor along with a room with one full size and one twin size bed. These two main floor bedrooms share a full size bathroom with shower/bathtub combination.

Advancing to the second floor you will be greeted by the large main living room which opens onto the eat-in kitchen island with 3 bar stools, a dining area that seats 7, and a laundry room. The upstairs hosts the two king master suite bedrooms, each which has its own private full en suite bathrooms with walk in glass showers. The living space has double doors that open onto the expansive front porch, complete with additional living and dining areas, an outdoor smart TV, and gas grill for your BBQ!

This home truly has everything you need to make unforgettable memories on your next vacation to Highway 30A! Book your next trip to the beach with Southern Holiday Homes today!

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps up to 11 Guests):

- - FIRST FLOOR - -
-Bedroom 1 - King bed with shared bathroom
-Bedroom 2 - Full bed and Twin bed with shared bathroom with tub/shower combination

- - SECOND FLOOR - -
-Master Bedroom 1 - King bed with en suite bathroom, large glass shower
-Master Bedroom 2 - King bed with en suite bathroom, large glass shower

Pack n' play is there for guests' use. An air mattress can be provided upon request.

*We also manage two other homes next to this one, if you have a large group but still want to stay close! They are Eastern Hideaway (277 Eastern Lake- 5 bedrooms) and The Jackpot (49 Brown St- 7 bedrooms). Based on availability, these homes can be rented out at the same time.

Guest access

There is parking for at least 4 cars in the driveway!

Other things to note
-Pet Friendly upon approval. A 40-pound weight limit applies, though exceptions may be considered. Please inquire for non-refundable pet fee based on breed/size.
-Check in is 4:00 PM & check out is 10:00 AM. Late check out / early check in will be subject to another day's rental fees.
-Please note we provide a starter set of supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dishwasher + laundry pods for your stay
-Smoking is strictly prohibited.
-All renters must be over 25 years of age, or if under age 25 must be accompanied by a parent/legal guardian.
-Pool heating must be for the duration of your stay and must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. Pool heating cost is $50/night of your reservation and is available October 1 - April 30.
-LSV/golf cart is not to be driven past the town of Alys Beach to the East or the town of WaterColor to the West. Resolving any issue from the LSV/golf cart battery dying because of the renters not charging it will be charged to the renters.
-Damage that occurs will be collected from the renters.
-Southern Holiday Homes can not be held liable for any damage or injury to any persons caused by LSV/golf cart, bikes, pool, or other amenities provided to guests.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
